epics.title: System Containerization and Deployment
epics.jtbd: When running the product locally, I want to start the full stack with a single command, so that I can verify its real-world behavior and observability.
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml at the repository root that starts the full stack and exposes a health-check endpoint.

slices.title: Add Docker Compose for Local Development
slices.jtbd: When implementing containerization for this epic, I want to add a docker-compose file, so that the product's real-world behavior and observability can be verified.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository root, When I run docker-compose up, Then the full stack starts successfully.
Given the running stack, When I query the health-check endpoint, Then it returns a 200 OK response.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local setup time from hours to under 5 minutes

epics.title: Epidemiological Material Cataloging and Management
epics.jtbd: When I manage the epidemiology knowledge base, I want to catalog and update materials, so that the information is structured and up to date.
requirements: R1: Enable updating existing materials via the UI.
R2: Enable deleting existing materials via the UI.

slices.title: Patch Material Update and Delete UI
slices.jtbd: When implementing the management UI for this epic, I want to connect the update and delete actions, so that the information is structured and up to date.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the system, When a user chooses to edit it from the UI, Then the frontend invokes the PUT endpoint and the catalog is updated.
Given an existing material, When a user chooses to delete it, Then the frontend invokes the DELETE API endpoint and it is removed.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Manual database updates for material management
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce material update time by 90% by removing manual database interventions

epics.title: System Authentication and Authorization
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
requirements: R1: Require user authentication to access the catalog.
R2: Block unauthenticated users and prompt them to log in when attempting to access the catalog or create a material.

slices.title: Enforce Authentication for Knowledge Base Access
slices.jtbd: When implementing access control for this epic, I want to enforce authentication checks, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to access the catalog, Then they are blocked and prompted to log in.
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to create a material, Then they are blocked and prompted to log in.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Missing route protection in existing application
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase coverage of authentication middleware to 100% of restricted routes
